LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Ppodae
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Ppodae (D-02-107) looks like an adorable white Pekingese puppy that wags its tail for Instinct care.\nYet non-Instinct handling or Bad results quickly erode its patience, unleashing a hulking tattooed beast that tears through anyone in its path before rolling back into containment stasis once sated.
